metadata.title: Purrge
metadata.description: Purrge by RabbittuX: AI-powered disk space manager for Windows and macOS. Warns when disk space is low, lets an AI (Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy or DeepSeek Harness) explain what can be cleaned, and deletes only what you approve. Run Install-Purrge after installing this module.

findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.
